steps.name: room_changed
steps.desc: The GM's room: Old Mill and Fen Crossing read Changed this session on their shelf rows (with their readiness after a middot); Old Mill is selected, with Save into map and Discard changes on a line under its row; Mossy Hollow, unchanged, keeps its readiness caption (staged)

steps.name: room_changed_no_folder
steps.desc: The GM's room with Fen Crossing selected, a changed map with no level folder here: a caption under its row says why (Kept for this session; not in your library) over Discard alone, and the line under its picture reads Changed this session (staged)

steps.name: 1280x720_room_full_changed
steps.desc: 1280x720: the GM's room with five maps on the shelf and Old Mill, changed, selected with Save into map and Discard under its row: the side sheet takes the full height and the shelf scrolls inside it (the selected row and its line in view), End session on the canvas at the foot (staged)

steps.name: drawer_changed
steps.desc: The room drawer over the table (glass): Mossy Hollow's row reads On the table · changed this session, selected, with Save into map and Discard changes under it; Old Mill reads Changed this session (staged)

steps.name: drawer_changed_mill
steps.desc: The room drawer with Old Mill (changed, not on the table) selected by a row click, which did not move the table: Save into map and Discard under its row, and the move is the action under the shelf, Move the table to Old Mill (staged)

steps.name: chip_player_map
steps.desc: A player's chip for a move to another map: map icon, 'Marigold is moving the table to Fen Crossing in 3' with the 3 in semibold tabular figures, no Stay here (staged)

steps.name: film_1_enter
steps.desc: Filmstrip 1: the GM's chip the moment it appears (fading in, M7: no slide)

steps.name: film_2_enter
steps.desc: Filmstrip 2: the chip about 0.2 s in, nearly opaque

steps.name: film_3_count3
steps.desc: Filmstrip 3: the chip at rest, Moving the table to Fen Crossing in 3, Stay here framed at 3:1

steps.name: film_4_count2
steps.desc: Filmstrip 4: in 2; the chip's width the same as at 3

steps.name: film_5_count1
steps.desc: Filmstrip 5: in 1; the chip's width the same again

steps.name: film_6_exit
steps.desc: Filmstrip 6: the chip fading out as at the count's end (a fresh chip dismissed and held halfway through its 0.15 s fade, alpha 0.5, so the frame shows it going whatever the capture's timing)

steps.name: chip_dusk
steps.desc: The GM's chip over the map at dusk (outdoor_sunset): users icon, 'Returning everyone to the room in 3' and Stay here, legible on the glass over a warm dark board

steps.to: The Drowned Lanterns of Upper Fenwick Mire

steps.name: 1280x720_chip_long_gm
steps.desc: 1280x720: the GM's chip for a long map name (The Drowned Lanterns of Upper Fenwick Mire): the name shortened with an ellipsis so the chip with Stay here stays in bounds, the count whole

steps.to: The Drowned Lanterns of Upper Fenwick Mire

steps.name: 1280x720_chip_long_player
steps.desc: 1280x720: a player's chip with a long GM name (Marigold Thistlewood-Ash) and a long map name: the GM's name gives way first, to Marigold and an ellipsis, then the map's with an ellipsis, the count whole

steps.to: The Drowned Lanterns of Upper Fenwick Mire

steps.name: 1280x720_chip_long_keeper
steps.desc: 1280x720: a player's chip whose GM's first word is no name alone (The Keeper): the name is kept whole, never cut to The, and the map's name gives way instead

steps.name: 1280x720_drawer_full_changed
steps.desc: 1280x720: the room drawer with five maps and Old Mill, changed, selected: the column scrolls with the selected row and its Save into map and Discard in view, Move the table to Old Mill and End session pinned at the foot (staged)

steps.to: The Drowned Lanterns of Upper Fenwick Mire

steps.name: 1280x720_confirm_save_long
steps.desc: 1280x720: Save into map's confirm for a long map name on the 420 sheet: the title wraps and alone names the map, the message the consequence (Every later session sets it out as it is now.), Cancel then Save into map

steps.to: The Drowned Lanterns of Upper Fenwick Mire

steps.name: 1280x720_confirm_discard_long
steps.desc: 1280x720: Discard changes' confirm for a long map name on the 420 sheet: the title wraps and alone names the map, the consequence (It goes back to how it was saved.), Discard changes in madder set apart at the left, Cancel alone at the right and focused

steps.name: 1280x720_save_failed
steps.desc: 1280x720: Save into map failed: the error toast, wrapping at 420 and up for about 12 s (its reading time), says what failed (could not save into Old Mill), why (its terrain file could not be written) and how to recover (the changes are still kept; check the maps folder, then try again)

steps.title: Table moves
steps.intro: The notice before the table moves (no prompt: the table is kept), and Save into map and Discard changes on a changed map's shelf row (cards table-moves-2 and table-moves-3: a full shelf scrolls, a row click never moves the table).
